shared_elements: low-relief figures shown in profile on a slab-like surface
horizontal upper register of repeated small motifs above a larger figural scene
band of short repeated strokes/hatching as a divider
figures placed side by side across the field
justification: The clearest correspondence is compositional rather than iconographic: both surfaces set a horizontal upper register of small repeated motifs (script-like signs in A, a row of arched/loop forms in B) above a larger field of relief figures rendered in flat, outlined, schematic profile. The decisive difference is subject matter — A shows a group of standing human figures with raised arms interacting with one another, while B shows animals (a bird in profile, a snake-like form, quadrupeds) with no human presence and no interaction of the same kind.
